Republicans promised to protect seniors. Instead, they’re shoving greedy corporations and AI middlemen between Texans and their doctors. 

That’s not protection — it’s a sellout. 

I’ll fight like hell to protect Texans’ health care. https://t.co/mIixdmhaap
Marley is new. She’s going to be imperfect at times. AI technology is still developing, and there will be moments where she doesn’t get it exactly right.
For the first time, a congressional campaign is putting an AI-powered tool in the hands of voters, not to replace real human connection but to extend it.

Pete Hegseth is bullying Anthropic into dropping its protections against the mass surveillance of the American people.

Building powerful technology responsibly isn’t something that should be punished — it should be encouraged. Americans deserve innovation that works for them, not at their expense.

https://t.co/R7p68nigfi

Dario Amodei is drawing a clear line: AI should defend democracy, not undermine it. Mass domestic surveillance. Fully autonomous weapons with no human oversight. These aren't just policy disagreements. They're threats to the freedoms our military exists to protect.

Threatening to brand an American company a security risk for refusing to build a surveillance state is exactly the kind of abuse of power that should alarm every Texan. Courage under that kind of pressure deserves recognition. Well done, Dario.
We have to have representatives who understand the technology, who aren’t afraid of it, who want to embrace its good sides, but also then put some rules that are relevant in place
